nodes.name: resignationService.ts
nodes.summary: Resignation service: API calls for submitResignation, getResignationStatus, approveResignation, rejectResignation, scheduleExitInterview, submitHandoverPlan, getFinalSettlement, and uploadOffboardingDoc. Uses apiClient with retry logic and Zod response validation.

nodes.name: ticketService.ts
nodes.summary: IT Ticket service: createTicket, getTickets (with filters), getTicketDetail, addComment, updateStatus, assignTicket, escalateTicket, getSLAStatus, and exportTickets. Implements optimistic updates for status changes and real-time subscription for comments.

nodes.name: workShiftService.ts
nodes.summary: Work Shift service: getShifts, getShiftTemplates, createShift, assignShift, swapShiftRequest, approveSwap, getShiftCalendar, detectConflicts, and bulkAssign. Integrates with attendance service for check-in validation.

nodes.name: aiService.ts
nodes.summary: AI Chat service: streamChat (Server-Sent Events), sendMessage, getConversations, getConversationHistory, deleteConversation, updateTitle, and uploadDocument. Handles streaming response parsing, citation extraction, and error retry with exponential backoff.

nodes.name: apiClient.ts
nodes.summary: Core API client: Axios instance with interceptors for auth token attachment, automatic refresh on 401, request/response logging, Zod schema validation, error normalization (ApiError), and request deduplication. Base URL from NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL.

nodes.name: employeeService.ts
nodes.summary: Employee service: getEmployees (pagination, filters, search), getEmployeeDetail, createEmployee, updateEmployee, terminateEmployee, getOrgChart, importEmployees, and exportEmployees. Handles avatar upload to MinIO and department sync.

nodes.name: assetService.ts
nodes.summary: Asset service: getAssets, getAssetCategories, createAssetRequest, approveRequest, assignAsset, returnAsset, scheduleMaintenance, getDepreciationReport, and bulkImport. Tracks asset lifecycle from procurement to disposal.

nodes.name: attendanceService.ts
nodes.summary: Attendance service: checkIn, checkOut, getAttendanceStatus, getLeaveBalance, requestLeave, requestOvertime, getTimesheet, submitTimesheet, and getTeamAttendance (manager). Validates geofence and work shift alignment.

nodes.name: performanceService.ts
nodes.summary: Performance service: getReviewCycles, getSelfReviews, getTeamReviews, submitSelfReview, submitManagerReview, calibrateScores, getScoreDistribution, and exportReviewData. Supports multi-rater (360) and calibration workflows.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: TypeScript type definitions: API response types (ApiResponse, PaginatedResponse), domain models (User, Employee, Asset, Ticket, Leave, Overtime, Payroll, Review), form schemas (Zod), and utility types (Nullable, OptionalKeys, DeepPartial).

nodes.name: dateRange.ts
nodes.summary: Date range utilities: parseRange, formatRange, getPresets (today, week, month, quarter, year), isInRange, addBusinessDays, getWorkingDays, and Vietnamese locale formatting (DD/MM/YYYY). Used across filters and reports.
